sloka: अयं च पुत्रो ऽतिबलस्तव रावण वीर्यवान् ।जगतीन्द्रजिदित्येव परिख्यातो भविष्यति ।। ७.३०.५ ॥
transliteration: ayaṁ ca putro 'tibalastava rāvaṇa vīryavān ।jagatīndrajidityeva parikhyāto bhaviṣyati ।। 7.30.5 ॥

translations.english: This exceedingly strong and valorous son of yours, O Ravana, will indeed be renowned in the world as Indrajit.
